verses.translation: The Inevitable Reality -
What is the Inevitable Reality?
And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
verses.translation: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,[1737] violent wind

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
verses.translation: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Then do you see of them any remains?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.translation: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities[1738] with sin.
verses.footnotes: [1738]- Those to which Lot was sent (see 11:82-83) or generally, all cities which were destroyed due to their denial of a messenger from Allāh.

verses.arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.translation: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship[1739]

verses.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
verses.translation: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.translation: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
verses.translation: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive
Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, dual, passive

verses.translation: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.[1740]

verses.arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌ
verses.translation: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.translation: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.[1741]
verses.footnotes: [1741]- i.e., any person or any secret you might attempt to conceal.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.translation: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
So he will be in a pleasant life -
In an elevated garden,
Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.translation: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth[1742] in the days past."
verses.footnotes: [1742]- Literally, "advanced" in anticipation of reward in the Hereafter.

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.translation: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And had not known what is my account.
I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.[1743]
verses.footnotes: [1743]- i.e., ending life rather than being the gateway to eternal life.

verses.translation: My wealth has not availed me.
Gone from me is my authority."[1744]
verses.footnotes: [1744]- i.e., I have no valid excuse to stand on.

verses.translation: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
Then into Hellfire drive him.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.translation: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translation: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
None will eat it except the sinners.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: So I swear by what you see

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: And what you do not see

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translation: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
We would have seized him by the right hand;[1745]
verses.footnotes: [1745]- Another interpretation is "by [Our] right hand," i.e., Allāh would have exacted revenge with might and power.

verses.translation: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.[1746]

verses.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
verses.translation: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
